name: Can I provide my own floor plan ideas for a custom tiny home design?
description: Yes, you can provide your own floor plan ideas; our designers will refine them to be functional, structurally sound, and code-compliant.

mainEntity.name: Can I provide my own floor plan ideas for a custom tiny home design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Your input is crucial for a truly custom tiny home design. We encourage clients to share any sketches, inspiration photos, or specific floor plan ideas they have. These initial concepts serve as a valuable starting point for our designers. Our team will then work with you to refine these ideas, ensuring they are structurally sound, code-compliant, and optimized for space and functionality. The goal is to translate your vision into a practical and beautiful living space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can provide your own floor plan ideas; our designers will refine them to be functional, structurally sound, and code-compliant.
